raw_text: Erdogan at OIC is doing exactly what Pakistan wants — internationalising Kashmir. But has anyone noticed the bot activity? Identical posts in English, Urdu, and Turkish appearing simultaneously across platforms. The hashtag #FreedomForKashmir was trending within 30 minutes of the speech despite minimal organic engagement. Classic amplification op.
clean_text: Reddit user identifies bot amplification campaign around Erdogan's OIC Kashmir speech. Identical multilingual posts and artificially trending hashtag detected within 30 minutes.
